born 22 June 1984) is a Serbian professional tennis player.","title":"Janko Tipsarević"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" His career-high singles ranking is world No. 8, achieved on 2 April 2012.","title":"Janko Tipsarević"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" In his career, he has won four ATP World Tour titles, one ATP doubles title, three Futures, and 15 Challenger titles.","title":"Janko Tipsarević"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" Tipsarević also won the 2001 Australian Open Junior title.","title":"Janko Tipsarević"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" Tipsarević has achieved two victories over a World No. 1 player, having defeated compatriot Novak Djokovic twice.","title":"Janko Tipsarević"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" He also has thirteen victories against other players in the top 10: four wins against Tomáš Berdych, and one each against Fernando González, Mikhail Youzhny, David Ferrer, James Blake, Gaël Monfils, Andy Murray and Juan Mónaco.","title":"Janko Tipsarević"},{"sentence_id":6,"text":" He holds victories over former World No. 1 players Carlos Moyá, Marat Safin, Lleyton Hewitt, Juan Carlos Ferrero and Andy Roddick.","title":"Janko Tipsarević"},{"sentence_id":7,"text":" His best results at a Grand Slam have been reaching the quarterfinals at the US Open in 2011 and 2012.","title":"Janko Tipsarević"},{"sentence_id":8,"text":" He is only the second Serb to reach the final 16 at all four different grand slams.","title":"Janko Tipsarević"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"Who was born first, Brooklyn Decker or Andy Roddick?"}
